name: ptee-windows-hns-tab
title: Policies on Windows: read the HNS tab
summary: The same Calico policy runs on Windows nodes, but the dataplane is different - Felix installs an HNS ACL list, not iptables. Load a policy, open the Windows (HNS) tab, and learn to read the flattened, IPv4-only ACL rules Felix hands the Host Networking Service.
